Specially the reception guy shubham  and the restaurant guy sahil! Helped us a lot during our stay! Thank you team remedra! I'll look forward to visit again

Hotel rooms are compact but well kept. Room service is little slow & needs improvements. Staff at the restaurant especially Ms Nikita, Sajda & Yogita has been pretty Pleasant disposition & with smiling face all the time. Good service attitude ! Hotel overall ambience is very good.  It was a pleasant stay on our business trip.

I recently stayed at this hotel and had a very pleasant experience. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained, with all the basic amenities I needed. The staff were friendly and helpful throughout my stay.

I would definitely consider staying here again and recommend it to anyone looking for a comfortable and reliable place to stay.
